fields.label: Ref Code
fields.description: The pack's own reference for this returnable, e.g. 'A4', 'Annexure B', 'Form C', '5.1(i)' — it becomes the form code on the rendered page and in the pack index

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The returnable's title as issued in the pack (hand-captured by the desk — no pack parsing, no AI)

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: Whether the pack marks this returnable mandatory (unticked = 'where the pack includes it')

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Buyer Form
Technical Returnable
Attachment
Legacy Preference Form
fields.description: 'Legacy Preference Form' marks pre-2011 HDI / 1939-Ordinance style buyer forms (e.g. Musina Forms C/D) — capturing their issued titles lets the WARN-PREF-CONFLICT lint fire on the generated pack (findings F-12)

fields.label: Kill Note
fields.description: The pack's own disqualification language for this returnable, quoted — renders as the red KILL NOTE on the worksheet page

fields.label: Template Code (optional)
fields.description: When this names an existing Tender Form Template code (e.g. MBD4, MBD6.1, ICT-CAPABILITY), that template's pre-filled worksheet renders for this row instead of the template-less placeholder page

fields.label: Guidance
fields.description: Desk guidance for completing this returnable — renders as the page's instruction notice when no template is linked

fields.label: Studio Document Scope (optional)
fields.description: Names the studio document that satisfies this returnable (e.g. 'Business Profile' — StartupOS's business_profile template, requested via a studio Document Request). Marks the row generate-via-studio (findings F-15): the worksheet page renders a pointer to generate the document instead of only the blank hand-fill placeholder

fields.label: Generated Artifact (optional)
fields.description: The studio-generated file that satisfies this returnable, attached once produced (findings F-15). When set, the worksheet page renders SATISFIED-BY-GENERATED-ARTIFACT provenance instead of the blank hand-fill placeholder. Deliberately NOT part of per-buyer seeding (seed_bid_returnables) — each bid attaches its own artifact. Gated like the F-13 dispatch outputs: it counts only generated-AND-attested — until artifact_attested is ticked, validate_submission_readiness fails with [RETURNABLE-ARTIFACT-UNATTESTED] and the pack never dispatches

fields.label: Artifact Attested
fields.description: Explicit desk attestation that the generated artifact was reviewed (generated-and-attested discipline, F-15/F-13): until ticked, validate_submission_readiness fails and the pack never dispatches — set via attach_returnable_artifact attest=1

fields.label: Artifact SHA-256
fields.description: Hex sha256 of the artifact's bytes, written on attach and RE-written at attest time (plan #11 immutability ledger): the digest fingerprints the document as the desk reviewed it, so a later edit to the file is detectable (compliance.dispatch_ledger.artifact_unaltered). Empty when hashing failed - never a fabricated digest
